## Motivation

The cookbook's **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083, #43799, #43983, #44065, #44228, #44654, #44712, #45039, #45111, #45311, #45513, #45749, #46005, #46506, #46547, #46807, #46948, #47027, #47214, #47464, #47929) mirror SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions. This PR:

1. **Syncs to InferenceX `main`** (`57116fff`). These merged lanes now come from their dashboard runs:
   - MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300 SGLang (TP2 / TP4 points): [InferenceX #4726](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4726), [run 41488743791](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41488743791), 2026-11-03. It was in progress in #47929 and is now verified.
   - MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang agg and disagg: [InferenceX #4750](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4750), [run 41528865560](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41528865560), 2026-11-03. #48070 had added these points by hand (6P1D c220 / c240 / c260 and the TP4 c1 MonoKernel point). The sync regenerates the file from InferenceX `main` and the dashboard, with the same points.
   - Overlaid in #47929 and since merged, on the same runs: Muse Spark Open B300 ([InferenceX #4725](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4725)) and GB300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4724](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4724)), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next B300 ([InferenceX #4683](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4683)) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603)).
   - PowerX re-runs, with provenance changes only (same commands): GLM-5.2 B200 Dynamo+SGLang agg / disagg ([InferenceX #4656](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4656)), GLM-5.2 FP8 B300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4702](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4702)) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GB300 ([InferenceX #4552](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4552)), all 2026-11-03.
2. **Overlays five open InferenceX PRs:**
   - Muse Spark Open GB300 Dynamo+SGLang: retuned aggregated points and new TP8 disaggregated points.
   - Muse Spark Open B200 and GB200 SGLang, retuned per concurrency.
   - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang HiCache disagg points on the `20261030` nightly.
   - MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB200 Dynamo+SGLang config.

## Source

| PR | Page | Lanes | Pinned to |
|---|---|---|---|

| [#4707](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4707) Muse Spark Open B200 SGLang, retuned per concurrency | Muse Spark Open | `musespark-fp4-b200-sglang-agentic-dflash` | [run 41297696082](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41297696082), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4707#issuecomment-6576173162) (head `c965ca2e`, unchanged), verified |
| [#4670](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4670) Muse Spark Open GB200 SGLang, retuned per concurrency | Muse Spark Open | `musespark-fp4-gb200-sglang-agentic-dflash` | [run 41096285400](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41096285400), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4670#issuecomment-6576162113) (head `c9eb455f`, unchanged), verified |
| [#4673](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4673) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang HiCache disagg, `20261030` nightly | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-dspark-disagg-hicache` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `be7bc6df` |
| [#4695](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4695) MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB200 Dynamo+SGLang config | MiniMax-M3.1 | `minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb200-dynamo-sglang-agentic-dspark-agg`, `-disagg` | [run 41271615328](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41271615328), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4695#issuecomment-6576168162) (head `fa292b90`, unchanged), verified |

"In progress" lanes are rendered at the PR head and labeled "In progress in SA InferenceX AgentX". A later sync pins them once the PR gets a `/use` run or merges.

- **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang is all in progress.** [InferenceX #4673](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4673) changes both GB300 Dynamo+SGLang keys, which takes all of their points. That includes the points `main` measured in [InferenceX #4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) / [#4679](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4679)'s run on 2026-10-30. They show as verified again once #4673 gets a `/use` run or merges.
- **Not overlaid: [InferenceX #4536](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4536)** (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B200 DRAM-offload points and TP2). It conflicts with InferenceX `main`. Its head predates [InferenceX #4598](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4598)'s FP8 draft KV (`speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3`) in the same B200 recipe, so overlaying it would replace #4598's measured points with a revision without that change. - **DeepSeek-V4 page unchanged**, as in #47464: [InferenceX #4664](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4664) retired DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
- **Not mirrored (unmeasured, unchanged):** `musespark-fp4-h100-sglang-agentic-dflash` and `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic`. The dashboard has no rows for them.
- InferenceX `main` was frozen for this PR at `57116fff`. Later merges are left for the next refresh.

| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3.1 | 8 | 40 (was 36) | 119 (was 118) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200 |
| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | unchanged | | | |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 10 | 22 (was 23) | 67 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 18 | 52 | 222 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 6 | 27 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 7 (was 6) | 15 (was 9) | 61 (was 56) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- **Eight new mirrored settings**, all on the Muse Spark Open GB300 Dynamo+SGLang lanes ([InferenceX #4757](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4757)), kept as submitted:
  - `SGLANG_TRTLLM_MHA_FULL_ATTN_KV_SPLITS` and `SGLANG_TRTLLM_MHA_FULL_ATTN_KV_SPLITS_MIN_BS`: TRT-LLM MHA full-attention decode / verify kernel tuning (minimum KV splits per request and KV head, and the batch size from which it applies).
  - `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_QUEUE_SIZE` and `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_THREAD_POOL_SIZE`: PD KV-transfer queues and thread pool.
  - `SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_CACHED_PREFIX=0`: the prefill worker does not send the KV of a cached prefix ahead of the forward pass.
  - `--optimistic-prefill-attempts`: prefill forward passes that may start before the bootstrap handshake completes.
  - `DYN_ROUTER_USE_KV_EVENTS=false` and `DYN_ROUTER_TTL_SECS` (Dynamo frontend): the KV router predicts cache state from its own routing decisions instead of worker KV events, and keeps predicted blocks for that long.
- The GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.5 data change only in their shared source block (the InferenceX `main` SHA and the overlay list).

- **Browser checks:** every page this PR changes was rendered in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI).
  - Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 3,152 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors.
  - Every tab was clicked, and all 170 "Copy link" URLs were reopened.
  - The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- **Decode and KV-flag checks:**
  - The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (3,152 router × KV-tier variants).
  - Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (215 image × flag pairs).
- **Arg-parse:** all 142 commands not validated in an earlier round parse:

  | Image | Commands | Parsed with |
  |---|---|---|
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261103-797af717` | 63 | the image (both platforms are built from `797af717`) |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261030-302b78cc` | 50 | the image, and again with SGLang `52604e1d` (its arm64 build's commit) for the GB300 lanes |
  | `v0.5.22-cu130` | 17 | the image |
  | `dev-minimax-m31-flash` | 6 | the image |
  | `nightly-cu134-20261030-e371881` (arm64 only) | 6 | SGLang `e3718813` source and the image's bundled `ai-dynamo` 1.7.0.dev20261030, on the amd64 `20261030` nightly |
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.
